job.title: VCE Leader & English Teacher
job.description:
Inspired Recruitment is partnering with a well regarded Catholic secondary school in Melbourne's west, near Werribee, to appoint a VCE Leader & English Teacher. This is a full-time, permanent position commencing in January 2027, and it offers a real opportunity to shape the senior years experience of a warm and close-knit school community.

About the role

As VCE Leader, you will take ownership of the school's VCE program, working alongside the leadership team to support senior students, guide staff and drive strong outcomes across Years 11 and 12. The position carries a teaching load of VCE English, so you will remain hands-on in the classroom while leading the wider program. You will be a visible presence for senior students and families, and a trusted point of contact for colleagues teaching in the VCE space.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate the school's VCE program, including assessment, SACs and VCAA compliance
  • Teach VCE English to Year 11 and 12 students with energy and expertise
  • Support, mentor and build capacity in the VCE teaching team
  • Monitor student progress and work closely with students, families and wellbeing staff
  • Contribute to the Catholic identity and broader life of the school

What we are looking for

  • Current registration with the Victorian Institute of Teaching (VIT) is essential
  • Proven experience teaching VCE English at Years 11 and 12 is required
  • Leadership experience in a secondary setting, or a clear readiness to step into a leadership role
  • A sound understanding of VCAA requirements and senior assessment practices
  • A practising Catholic, or someone who is willing to support and uphold the Catholic ethos of the school, is desired
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, student-centred approach

What is on offer

A full-time, permanent leadership position with a salary of $138,000 to $150,000 (based on the new award that will be approved by the DOE/MACS) plus superannuation, commencing January 2027. You will join a supportive leadership team in a school that values its staff, invests in professional growth and places students at the heart of everything it does. The school is easily accessible from Melbourne's western suburbs and surrounding areas.

How to apply

If this sounds like the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you. Click Apply Now to submit your CV, or reach out to Lucas Leonard at Inspired Recruitment for a confidential conversation about the role and the school. Applications will be reviewed as they are received, so please do not wait to get in touch.

job.title: Leadership Roles in QLD | Head of Department (Business) & Boarding Head of Year
job.description:
Two leadership roles. One outstanding Queensland grammar school. A lifestyle Melbourne can only dream about in July.

Inspired Recruitment is partnering with one of Queensland's most respected grammar schools to appoint two senior leaders for a January 2027 start. The school sits half an hour from the coast, close enough for a swim before school or a weekend on the sand, yet far enough from the city to enjoy space, sunshine and a real sense of community. If you have ever wondered what your career and your life might look like a little further north, this is the moment to find out.

This is a school with a long and proud history, strong academic results, a thriving boarding community and a reputation that carries weight across the state and beyond. Leadership here is well supported, well resourced and taken seriously. Both roles are full-time and permanent.

Head of Department: Business Studies

You will lead a talented and committed Business faculty across the senior years, shaping curriculum, driving teaching quality and inspiring students to think commercially and creatively about the world around them. You will mentor your team, oversee assessment and moderation, contribute to whole-school academic strategy and build a department that students want to be part of. We are looking for an experienced Business Studies teacher with a proven record of strong senior results and either current leadership experience or a clear readiness to step up.

Salary: $154k - 160k + super based on experience

Boarding Head of Year

Boarding is at the heart of this school and the Head of Year is at the heart of boarding. You will take pastoral responsibility for a year group of boarders, working closely with families, boarding staff, teaching staff and the wider wellbeing team to make sure every student feels known, safe and supported. You will lead a team of boarding supervisors, coordinate the daily rhythm of boarding life, manage wellbeing and behaviour with warmth and consistency, and help young people from regional Queensland and beyond thrive away from home. Experience in boarding or residential care is highly regarded, as is a genuine passion for pastoral leadership. A teaching load forms part of this role.

Salary: $92k to $130k + super based on experience + accomodation provided

What the school offers

A competitive leadership salary with allowances, relocation support for interstate appointments, a beautiful campus with excellent facilities, a collegial and forward-thinking executive team, real investment in your professional growth, and a coastal Queensland lifestyle that makes the Monday commute feel very different.

What you will need

Current registration with the Queensland College of Teachers (QCT), or eligibility to obtain it before January 2027. Registered teachers from Victoria and other states can transfer through mutual recognition, and we will guide you through the process. You will also need relevant tertiary qualifications, a strong record of teaching practice, and the leadership qualities that bring out the best in students and colleagues.

Ready to head north?

Apply now with your CV and a short cover letter telling us which role you are applying for and why. Every application is treated in strict confidence. For a confidential conversation about the school, the roles or what a move to Queensland could look like for you and your family, contact Lucas Leonard at Inspired Recruitment on Lucas.Leonard@inspiredrec.com.au.

job.title: 2027 Primary & Secondary Teachers
job.description:
Teach where you are wanted, in the school that actually fits you

  • Middle Years Teachers, Years 5 to 9
  • Secondary School Teachers, Years 7 to 12, including VCE
  • Special Needs and Special Education Teachers, Specialist Schools, autism specific schools and inclusion support
  • Learning Support, Intervention and Literacy and Numeracy Specialists
  • Leading Teachers, Learning Specialists, Heads of Faculty, Heads of Year, Assistant Principals and Principals

We recruit across the full Victorian Curriculum F to 10 and VCE. If you teach it, we most likely have a school asking for it.

English: English, English as an Additional Language (EAL), Literacy, Literature, English Language

Mathematics: Mathematics, Numeracy, General Mathematics, Mathematical Methods, Specialist Mathematics, Foundation Mathematics

Science: Science, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Psychology, Earth and Space Sciences, Biological Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Physical Sciences, Environmental Science

The Humanities: Civics and Citizenship, Economics and Business, Geography, History, Legal Studies, Accounting, Business Management, Politics, Sociology, Classical Studies, Religion and Society, Religious Education, Texts and Traditions

Health and Physical Education: Health and Physical Education, HPE, PE, Sport Science, Outdoor and Environmental Studies, Health and Human Development, Food Studies

The Arts: Dance, Drama, Theatre Studies, Media Arts, Media, Music, Instrumental Music, Visual Arts, Art Making and Exhibiting, Art Creative Practice, Visual Communication Design, Studio Arts, Photography

Technologies: Design and Technologies, Digital Technologies, Applied Computing, Software Development, Data Analytics, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Product Design and Technologies, Materials Technology, Wood, Metal and Textiles, Food Technology, Agricultural and Horticultural Studies

Languages: Arabic, Auslan, Chinese, Classical Greek, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latin, Modern Greek, Spanish, Turkish, Vietnamese, Victorian Aboriginal Languages, and other Roman and non-Roman alphabet languages, plus LOTE and CLIL programs

Capabilities and cross-curriculum: Critical and Creative Thinking, Ethical Capability, Intercultural Capability, Personal and Social Capability, Respectful Relationships, Careers and Pathways

Senior secondary pathways: VCE, VCE Vocational Major, Victorian Pathways Certificate, VET in Schools, VCE Extended Investigation, International Baccalaureate PYP, MYP and Diploma

Where the work is

Some of our strongest school partnerships sit in Gippsland, Mildura and Wodonga, including Traralgon, Sale, Bairnsdale, Morwell, Warragul, Leongatha, Wangaratta, Wodonga, Albury, Mildura, Swan Hill and Robinvale. These schools move fast, they look after the teachers who join them, and many offer relocation support, subsidised housing and incentive payments.

We also recruit right across Melbourne, including the CBD and inner city, Inner North, Inner West, Northern Suburbs, Eastern Suburbs, South Eastern Suburbs, Bayside, Mornington Peninsula, Yarra Ranges, Melton, Wyndham, Werribee, Casey and Cardinia, plus Geelong and the Bellarine, Ballarat, Bendigo, Shepparton, Warrnambool, Horsham and Colac.

What you will need

  • Current VIT registration, or an application in progress, or eligibility to register with the Victorian Institute of Teaching
  • A recognised teaching qualification, Bachelor of Education, Master of Teaching or equivalent
  • A current Working with Children Check, or willingness to obtain one
  • The right to work in Australia, and we support skilled visa and sponsorship pathways for the right candidates
  • Overseas trained teachers are very welcome, and we will guide you through AITSL skills assessment and VIT registration step by step

What you will get

  • Competitive Victorian teacher salaries, with the new Victorian Government Schools Agreement lifting rates significantly, and independent and Catholic schools setting their own scales that often sit above award
  • Access to permanent, ongoing, contract and fixed term roles, many of which are never advertised publicly
  • Salary packaging, professional development funding, mentoring for graduates and genuine progression to Learning Specialist and leadership
  • A consultant who knows the schools personally and will be honest with you about culture, workload and leadership before you commit
  • Support with your CV, interview preparation and referees at no cost to you, because schools pay our fees, not teachers

Ready when you are

Apply now with your CV, or register your interest for Term 1 and we will keep you in the loop as roles come through. Even if you are just starting to look, have a confidential chat with us and see what is out there.

Teacher salaries in Australia range from around $85,000 to $145,000 AUD + 12% superannuation, depending on the state or territory, your years of experience and any leadership responsibilities.
